song.author: David A Graham
song.title: In Moments Like these
song.lyrics:
[V1] .C Am F G In moments like these I sing out a song .F G C G I sing out a love song to Jesus. .C Am F G In moments like these I lift up my hands .F G C I lift up my hands to the Lord
[C1] . F G C Singing I love You, Lord . F G C Singing I love You, Lord . F G Am F Singing I love You, Lord . C G C I love You
